capabilities: Set up a periodic-notes workspace with or without PARA via a first-run wizard
Capture quick records and tasks into daily notes
Query tasks, records and resources with Dataview views
Provide starter templates for daily to yearly and PARA notes
Create tagged theme folders with index notes and snapshots
extras: Freemium: quick capture and basic task entry are free, while calendar planning, advanced lists and project workflows sit in the separately paid LifeOS Pro plugin; AI features need the separate DeepAsk plugin plus a model service. Query views require Dataview, but setup and capture work without it. Won third place in the Best Templates category at the 2024 Obsidian Gems of the Year awards; deeper tutorials live in external guide sites and the LifeOS-example vault.
problem: Obsidian ships no opinionated PARA folder system or periodic life-planning workspace, so users must assemble folders, templates, and capture workflows themselves.

relations.evidence: The underlying plugin uses dataview's query interface.
Provides decoupled template creation, allowing a very large number of plugins to create files
Gave me the inspiration to develop this plugin.
Thanks to cotemaxime for creating such a great starter vault.

summary: Life management plugin that sets up a PARA-based periodic-notes workspace with quick capture, starter templates, and Dataview query views.
